svg.title: Two variables sliding along the table
svg.desc: Only two cells stay alive: prev2 (blue) and prev1 (amber); older cells are dropped. (prev2, prev1) after each step: start (1, 2), i = 2 (2, 5), i = 3 (5, 12), i = 4 (12, 29), i = 5 (29, 70); the answer is prev1 = 70.
svg.text: O(1) space: only two cells stay alive
